articles.title: Mariners suffer through another painful loss to Athletics
articles.description: Just about everything that has tormented the Mariners this season occurred in microcosm during Saturday’s 6-2 loss to the Athletics.

articles.title: Yes, the Mariners can still make the playoffs. But common sense says otherwise.
articles.description: The math says it’s possible for the Mariners to make the playoffs. But nothing about this team indicates they have a miracle run in them to reach October.

articles.title: Bryan Woo’s career-best start helps Mariners avoid sweep to A’s
articles.description: In the best start of his career, Bryan Woo allowed only one hit over eight dominant innings, helping the Mariners avoid an embarrassing four-game sweep to the Athletics.

articles.title: Photos: Seattle Mariners lose to Athletics, 6-2
articles.description: Jennifer Buchanan is a staff photographer for The Seattle Times who covers general news with a heavy emphasis on sports.

articles.title: Mariners’ Logan Gilbert sets unwanted record in loss to A’s
articles.description: Logan Gilbert, the pitcher the Mariners have turned to so often when they desperately needed a victory this season, unexpectedly faltered Friday night in a loss to the A's.

articles.title: Mariners fall to Athletics, lose ground in AL West race
articles.description: Needing to stack wins, the Mariners struck out a season-high 18 times and stranded a dozen baserunners to open their homestand Thursday with a 7-4 loss to the Athletics.

articles.title: Mariners open ‘Legacy Plaza’ featuring statue of iconic 2001 American flag moment
articles.description: The Mariners opened “Legacy Plaza” with the unveiling of a statue of a memorable 2001 moment featuring Mike Cameron and Mark McLemore hoisting the American flag.

articles.title: Mariners rule Matt Brash out for season after injury setback
articles.description: Mariners general manager Justin Hollander made it official before Friday’s game — Matt Brash won’t pitch again in 2026 after suffering a setback in his injury rehab.

articles.title: Mariners promote top hitting prospect Michael Arroyo
articles.description: Their playoff hopes all but dead, the Mariners made a clear move for the future Sunday by promoting top hitting prospect Michael Arroyo from Triple-A Tacoma.

articles.title: Mariners offense erupts again to claim series win in Boston
articles.description: The Mariners offense wrapped up one of its most productive series of the season in an 8-3 victory over the Red Sox at Fenway Park on Wednesday, wrapping up a key series win.
